reason: Anti-leakage review: a global±1gap mask could use a not-yet-observed future missingness flag to remove the preceding training session. Replace that sensitivity with an as-of causal rule before delivery.
supersedes: Original plan gap_guard wording for training/evaluation masks only
training_rule: At monthly origin, consult missing flags only through origin; remove±1sessions around those already-known gaps inside training window.
evaluation_rule: Remove originally missing target and first session after an already-observed missing day; do not remove a target merely because a future gap will occur.
scope: Sensitivity only; retrospective universe and provider-vintage biases remain.
